item.description: New York City police are on the scene of a tragic boating accident where a woman and a young child were killed near the Statue of Liberty. The NYPD says they got a call about an overturned boat and when crews arrived, they found 12 people had already been rescued from the water but a 27-year-old woman and five-month-old little girl did not survive. WNBC’s Jessica Cunnington reports for Sunday TODAY.

item.description: A Roman-era shipwreck that has remained untouched on the seabed for more than 2,000 years has been uncovered by divers off the coast of Sicily, police on the Mediterranean island said.

media:content.media:text:
Ministry of Culture posts video of Roman finds near Trapani, Italy.
About three miles off the coast of Mazara del Vallo, at a depth of 46 meters, a Roman shipwreck has been discovered, believed to date from between the 2nd and 1st centuries B.C., containing hundreds of amphorae, two large lead anchor stocks, and other artifacts.
media:content.media:description:
Ministry of Culture posts video of Roman finds near Trapani, Italy.
About three miles off the coast of Mazara del Vallo, at a depth of 46 meters, a Roman shipwreck has been discovered, believed to date from between the 2nd and 1st centuries B.C., containing hundreds of amphorae, two large lead anchor stocks, and other artifacts.

media:content.media:text: Experts have dated the vessel back to the first or second century.
media:content.media:description: Experts have dated the vessel back to the first or second century.

media:content.media:text: The amphorae were discovered inside the shipwreck, alongside lead anchor stocks and other artifacts.

item.title: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Italian coast

item.description: The man accused of planning the murder of Tupac Shakur is set to stand trial as prosecutors look to prove Duane "Keefe D" Davis orchestrated the drive-by shooting that killed the hip-hop legend nearly 30 years ago. NBC’s Chloe Melas reports and senior legal correspondent Laura Jarrett joins TODAY with analysis.
